This table describes the sample construction procedures. We begin with Thomson Reuters insider trading
data for Form 4 filings between March 1, 2012, and December 31, 2013. We then merge in data from
three other sources. First, we add in the Form 4 insider trading time-date stamps obtained from the SEC’s
EDGAR filing system. Second, we merge in details about the Dow Jones media coverage of the filings.
Finally, we incorporate TAQ data.
